# A picture of motion

<!-- STEP id="table" -->
A graph shows how one quantity changes with another. All graphs in this chapter are for motion in a straight line, in one direction.

Table 4.3 gives the position of a vehicle at each second: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and 120 m at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 s.

<!-- STEP id="axes" -->
Put time on the X-axis and position on the Y-axis. Choose scales that fit the paper. Here 5 small squares stand for 1 s, and 5 small squares stand for 20 m.
